metadata.description: Collection of Agent Skills created by @lloliveiradev for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and any agent that speaks the open Skills spec.

plugins.name: pm-tasks-core
plugins.description: Shared extraction engine and canonical CRUD verb vocabulary (task.create, task.close, task.due-date.set, …) for the pm-tasks-* adapters. Dependency of every adapter.

plugins.name: pm-tasks-trello
plugins.description: Turn implementation plans into Trello cards and checklists — paste-ready output, MCP publish, or autonomous write-through. Requires pm-tasks-core.

plugins.name: pm-tasks-asana
plugins.description: Turn plans into Asana tasks and subtasks with custom fields and section placement — paste, MCP publish, or autonomous mode. Requires pm-tasks-core.

plugins.name: pm-tasks-jira
plugins.description: Turn plans into Jira issues with epics, estimates, and workflow transitions — paste, Atlassian MCP publish, or autonomous mode. Requires pm-tasks-core.

plugins.name: pm-tasks-linear
plugins.description: Turn plans into Linear issues with sub-issues, estimates, and cycles (sprints) — paste-ready, Linear MCP publish, or autonomous mode. First pm-tasks adapter with sprint support. Requires pm-tasks-core.

plugins.name: django-schema-design
plugins.description: Design Django database schemas with expert trade-offs — PK strategy (incremental/UUIDv4/UUIDv7 insert locality), indexes, constraints, and safe migrations. Knowledge skill, no MCP.
